lines: Khecarī by throwing goddess five-Kuṇḍalinī held; dissolution-mudrā and this indeed if upward is thrown indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: drākkṣepātkhecarī devī pañcakuṇḍalinī matā saṃhāramudrā caiṣaiva yadyūrdhvaṃ kṣipyate kila
